basic_profile.bio: A passionate hobbyist photographer based in Southern California, specializing in film photography and digital editing. I work as a freelance graphic designer and spend my free time developing film and exploring creative projects. I'm always on the lookout for new techniques and tools to enhance my work. I dislike overly complex subscription models, preferring flexibility in my software tools. I generally browse Reddit in the evenings and late at night after work. I'm currently single and enjoy attending local photography meetups.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I gained my expertise in photography through a combination of formal education in graphic design and self-taught exploration of film development and digital editing. Over the years, I've honed my skills using various Adobe products and regularly keep up with the latest tools and trends in the photography community.
